summary: Almost all disinformation happens on nine web properties. Facebook owns four of them. Best way to fight disinformation is to quit Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp. Encourage family, especially older relatives, to do the same
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Almost all disinformation happens on nine web properties.

Facebook owns four of them.

Best way to fight disinformation is to quit Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp.

Encourage family, especially older relatives, to do the same
